extras: Requires macOS. Does not install or update Kiro CLI. No telemetry or ads.
intentEvidence: A small ACP (Agent Client Protocol) chat sidebar for your notes.
problem: Users need a way to interact with local AI agents using the context of their Obsidian notes and files.

relations.evidence: Kiro V3 CLI is the currently supported provider

summary: A chat sidebar for Obsidian that connects to a local ACP agent (Kiro CLI) to allow users to interact with and analyze notes and files within the vault.
